sources.title: sabia-7b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview sabia-7b is a Portuguese-language autoregressive model developed by maritaca-ai that uses the LLaMA-1-7B architecture and tokenizer. The model contains 7 billion parameters and was pretrained on 7 billion tokens from the Portuguese subset of ClueWeb22, starting from LLaMA-1-7B weights and undergoing an additional 10 billion tokens of training (approximately 1.4 epochs). This project was the final assingment of Natural Language Processing class, taught by Yuri Malheiros. The base model was developed by Maritaca AI. See the base model.
